full_details: St Helen's bell at first light. A fresh leaf, headed 1594, because the legal year has not turned. The first line is the Queen, for two plays at Greenwich at Christmas, twenty pounds, not yet had. You wrote Greenwich from memory. You have not seen a warrant. Under it, the coffer, twenty-four pound ten, then Two Gentlemen on St Stephen's night and Errors on Innocents' Day, then three winter marks: the comedy before Shrovetide, no tavern scores, silver home at Lent. A pan went down in the kitchen. You added one private line, that the year begins with demands from below. In the almanac, Candlemas is the twins' day and Lady Day is rent. At the stair you paid Mistress Ansell sixpence for firing and washing, and threepence for the board, and you ate at noon. The afternoon was the fifth act, unfinished. Two Gentlemen played at the Cross Keys and you were not in it. The light failed with the Worthies only begun.
one_sentence: You opened the year's book while it was still 1594, paid the sixpence and the noon threepence, and wrote at the oath until the light failed.
title: Opened the year's book until the light failed
